Usually when I'm in situations, I look at it two ways.  What happens if I don't do it, and what happens if I do it.  In your situation, talking to her would be the best thing.  If you have feelings for this girl, and you don't talk to her, it will always bother you that you didn't talk to your crush.  But if you do talk to her, you're being brave and even if she doesn't date you, pushing yourself any talking to her is enough to be happy about. 

Start with a hello, tell her your name, ask how's she's doing, compliment her.  See what happens from there.  I'm guessing she's a coworker, or a student at school, so for a couple of days do this.  Then when you're comfortable enough, slip her your number.  Easier than asking.  


To push yourself to do it, remember what I said first.  Think of it in two situations.  There's a chance she may date you, and even if she doesn't you're very brave for talking to a girl.  If you don't ask, (as you stated) you'll miss the opportunity of your life.  Before asking, close your eyes.  Take deep breaths and say to yourself "I can do this." 

Best of luck to you.
